title: Numerical companion to: A Static Axisymmetric Deformation of Nariai Geometry
description:
Scripts reproducing the numerical results of the paper A Static Axisymmetric Deformation of Nariai Geometry: Nonround Horizons without Rotation or Conical Defects.

energy_conditions.py reproduces the weak/dominant energy-condition threshold λc = 0.363619247… at 30 significant digits (Sec. 7.3). horizon_figure.py builds the horizon-geometry figure and table (Sec. 5.3). crosscheck.py verifies that the two independent Legendre-function implementations agree.
